packageRules.description: One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps rather than five.

customManagers.description: The golangci-lint version passed to golangci-lint-action. The github-actions manager does not look inside a `with:` input, and a linter built with an older Go than the go directive refuses to load the config at all — which is how this repo's first CI run failed.
The Go version pinned in setup-go, kept in step with the go directive in go.mod. A new Go release is also the release radar's trigger, so this PR is a work item, not just housekeeping.
